name: Maintained emergency luminaire plan mark
summary: Plan mark for an emergency luminaire whose lamp is lit at all times and stays lit on supply failure.
description: A maintained emergency luminaire operates as a normal light and continues on battery when the normal supply fails. Plans usually draw the luminaire mark with an emergency indicator, such as a filled segment or a letter E, plus an M or maintained tag.

Maintained operation is common in places of assembly, cinemas and some exit signs. The fitting needs both a switched supply for normal operation (where switched maintained) and an unswitched permanent supply to charge the battery and sense failure.
The tag does not give the duration. Emergency duration (for example 1 h or 3 h) should appear in the schedule or legend.
readingNotes: Look for the M tag or legend key.
Check the unswitched supply is shown.
drawingChecklist: Mark test facility or self-test type.
distinction: A non-maintained emergency luminaire lights only on supply failure; the maintained form is lit continuously.
